questions.q: What is the Workflows UI, according to this lesson?
options: A Python module for writing pipeline code
A tool exclusively for editing databricks.yml files as text
The visual canvas for building and monitoring a job's tasks and dependencies
A separate kind of job distinct from one built via Asset Bundles
questions.explain: The Workflows UI is the visual way a person builds and watches the exact same job object Lesson 17 introduced.

questions.q: What settings live inside a single task box in the Workflows UI?
options: Only the cron schedule
Only the task's name
Task type, cluster, and parameters
The entire workspace's Unity Catalog metastore configuration
questions.explain: Clicking a task box opens its type, which cluster runs it, and any parameters passed in — matching what a bundle's YAML would declare in text.

questions.q: What does the run graph view show while a job is actively running?
options: The job's total historical cost
Only a single overall pass/fail result at the very end
A static diagram that never updates during a run
Each task box changing color as it queues, runs, and finishes, watched task by task
questions.explain: The canvas becomes a live status view during a run, showing each task's real-time state rather than only a final result.

questions.q: According to this lesson, what is the relationship between a job built in the Workflows UI and the same job declared in a Databricks Asset Bundle?
options: Only the Asset Bundle version can use job clusters
They are fundamentally incompatible and cannot represent the same job
The Workflows UI version always runs faster
They produce the identical underlying job object — two different ways to author the same configuration
questions.explain: Neither is 'the real one' — both the visual canvas and the YAML bundle produce the same underlying job object.

questions.q: What does dragging a line between two task boxes in the Workflows UI actually set?
options: A permanent, unchangeable execution order that ignores Run if conditions
The cluster size for both tasks
A dependency between the two tasks
Nothing — dependencies must be typed manually in JSON
questions.explain: Dragging a line sets a dependency, which Lesson 19 covers in full including the Run if conditions that can modify its behavior.
